name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=battle/spell). Name accurately reflects behavior: looks up the spell effect entry for spell_id, reads its heal HP value (entry+0), and applies it to the given battle target via fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Caller fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast and inner fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp both corroborate the heal-application semantics.
purpose: Apply a heal spell to one battle target: resolve the spell's heal HP value and heal the target (with XP award handled by the inner heal fn), returning the actual heal amount.
logic_summary: Two-line dispatcher. spell_entry = fd2_get_spell_effect_entry(spell_id); reads heal HP value at *(int16*)spell_entry (spell effect entry +0); return fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp(target_idx, heal_value). The return value (actual applied heal) is tail-propagated from the inner fn's EAX -- the asm tail (CALL inner; ADD ESP,8; POP EBX; RET) leaves EAX untouched. __CHK(0x10,...) is the Watcom stack-probe prologue.

params.name: target_idx
params.semantics: Index of the battle participant (target slot) receiving the heal; passed straight through to fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp. Caller passes the per-target id p_targets[i] from the AoE target list.
params.reason: Accurately names the target slot index used to locate the unit to heal. No address residue, matches caller usage.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell ID (valid range 0x00-0x23) used to look up the spell effect entry whose +0 int16 is the heal HP value. Reached at runtime via variant-B spell ids 0xD/0xE/0xF/0x10.
params.reason: Accurately names the spell identifier; 0x00-0x23 is the meaningful spell-ID domain (not address residue). Matches caller (EDI=spell_id).

returns.semantics: Actual heal amount applied (= inner fd2_apply_hp_heal_and_award_xp return, extra_heal + base_heal). The sole caller fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast feeds it to fd2_show_damage_number(heal_amount, 0x69, target_id) to display the floating heal number ('i' indicator).

notes: Clean 2-line heal-spell dispatcher. Source comment block (lines 87-96) and Ghidra plate are both already accurate and mutually consistent -- no edits to src comment or plate. name_verdict=keep, both params keep. No logic concerns.
